legend: Gaz is an infinite city. The streets of this city are as follows :
The streets of this city can be introduced on the two-dimensional coordinate system as follows :
A horizontal street coinciding with the x−$$$x-$$$axis.
A vertical street coinciding with the y−$$$y-$$$axis.
For every natural number n$$$n$$$, there is a circular street with radius n$$$n$$$ with the center of (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$ coordinate.

We know that Alice is currently at a junction with coordinate (x1,y1)$$$(x_1, y_1)$$$ and Bob is currently at a junction with coordinate (x2,y2)$$$(x_2, y_2)$$$. A junction is a point at intersection of two streets. For example, (0,1)$$$(0,1)$$$ and (0,−1)$$$(0,-1)$$$ are junctions formed from intersection of horizontal street and circular streets with radius 1$$$1$$$.
Alice wants to know the shortest distance that she has to walk in the streets of Gaz to reach Bob.
input: In the first line of input you'll be given a number t$$$t$$$ −$$$-$$$ the number of the testcases.
In each of the next t$$$t$$$ lines, you'll receive 4$$$4$$$ integers x1,y1,x2,y2$$$x_1, y_1, x_2, y_2$$$ which show the coordinates of the junctions where Alice and Bob are located.
It is guaranteed that at least one of x1,y1$$$x_1, y_1$$$ and at least one of x2,y2$$$x_2, y_2$$$ will be 0$$$0$$$.
output: For each test, print only one line containing a single floating-point number −$$$-$$$ the minimum answer. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$.
